title: Synergy Rules Engine
description: The Central Rules Engine that defines ALL synergistic relationships in the game. All connection/synergy blocks in individual data files are DEPRECATED in favor of this unified system. Rules are arbitrated by Specificity, Exclusion, and Priority.

rule_id.description: Unique identifier for this synergy rule (e.g., 'heroic_reputation_bonus', 'wookiee_guardian_rage').

name.description: Human-readable name for this synergy rule.

description.description: Rich narrative description of what this synergy represents and why it exists.

priority.description: Priority for rule resolution when multiple rules could apply. Higher values take precedence. Default is 50.

trigger.description: Conditions that must be met for this synergy to activate.

actor_tags.description: Tags that the actor (character/creature performing the action) must have. ALL tags must be present (AND logic).

actor_tags_any.description: Tags where at least ONE must be present on the actor (OR logic).

actor_tags_exclude.description: Tags that the actor must NOT have.

target_tags.description: Tags that the target must have. ALL tags must be present (AND logic).

target_tags_any.description: Tags where at least ONE must be present on the target (OR logic).

target_tags_exclude.description: Tags that the target must NOT have.

action_tags.description: Tags that the action/power/item being used must have.

action_tags_any.description: Tags where at least ONE must be present on the action (OR logic).

context_tags.description: Environmental or situational tags that must be present (e.g., 'in_space', 'underwater', 'during_combat').

custom_conditions.description: Advanced conditional logic for complex synergies.

parameters.description: Parameters specific to the condition type.

narrative_context.description: Narrative description of when this synergy should trigger, for LLM-GM guidance.

mechanical_effect.description: The mechanical effects applied when this synergy triggers.

type.description: The type of mechanical effect this synergy provides.

parameters.description: Parameters specific to the effect type. Structure varies by type.

target_stat.description: For stat modifications, the stat being modified.

value.description: The value of the effect (varies by type: integer, string, object, etc.).

damage_type.description: Type of damage for damage effects.

status_id.description: ID of status effect to apply/remove.

condition.description: Additional condition that must be met for this specific effect.

notes.description: Human-readable notes about this effect for LLM-GM and players.

exclusions.description: Other rule_ids that this rule conflicts with. If both would trigger, the one with higher priority wins.

stacks_with.description: Rule_ids that this rule can stack with (both can apply simultaneously).

narrative_enhancement.description: Rich narrative description for the LLM-GM of how this synergy manifests in the story.

llm_guidance.description: Guidance for the LLM-GM on how to narrate and apply this synergy.

roleplay_guidance.description: How this synergy should be portrayed in roleplay.

tactical_notes.description: Tactical advice for using this synergy effectively.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks that can arise from this synergy.

source_data.description: Metadata about where this synergy rule came from (for migration tracking).

migrated_from.description: Original files and locations this rule was migrated from.

last_modified.description: When this rule was last updated.

active.description: If false, this rule is disabled and will not trigger.
